{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
df = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Drop refunded orders — they don't contribute to real revenue
df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Now, restrict to converted orders — the estimand is revenue per converted order
converted_df = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Verify: only converted orders
print(f'Number of converted orders: {len(converted_df)}')

# Compute average revenue per converted order, within each customer segment
grouped = converted_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue'].mean().reset_index()

grouped = grouped.rename(columns={'revenue': 'avg_revenue_per_converted_order'})

grouped.sort_values(['channel', 'customer_segment'])"}
